newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss overnight hotel stays fall 5.1 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Swiss overnight hotel stays fall 5.1 pct in August.

text.p: Overnight stays in Swiss hotels declined 5.1 percent to 3.58 million in August from the same month last year, continuing this year's negative trend, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Visits by Swiss citizens fell four percent to 1.34 million with unstable weather, the early end to an average summer and stagnating household income cited as the main factors.
The decline in visits by foreigners was due mainly to an 8.7 percent drop in visits by Germans.
For the first eight months of 1996, overnight stays fell by 5.3 percent to 21.59 million. Swiss youth hostels reported a 2.3 perent decline in the January-August period.
